```sql
WITH wholesale_orders AS (
    SELECT
        l.sales_order_id,
        l.order_date,
        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN l.currency = 'AUD' THEN l.net_value * COALESCE(f.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0)
                ELSE l.net_value
            END
        ) AS order_revenue
    FROM staging.stg_erp__sales_order_lines l
    LEFT JOIN staging.stg_erp__fx_rates f
        ON l.order_date = f.rate_date
    WHERE l.order_date BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2026-03-31'
    GROUP BY l.sales_order_id, l.order_date
)
SELECT CAST(AVG(order_revenue) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS answer
FROM wholesale_orders;
```
